description: Ziad M. Ali publishes GAMS code and Excel results for a two-stage battery-allocation and microgrid-operation study. The April 2025 deposit is freely downloadable under CC BY 4.0 and is explicitly linked by the PLOS One paper’s data-availability statement. The study uses a modified IEEE 33-bus system with five photovoltaic and five wind units, comparing sodium-sulfur and sodium-nickel-chloride storage configurations. BONMIN solves the mixed-integer nonlinear formulation in GAMS. These materials can support comparison of hosting-capacity and energy-dispatch simulations. The deposited code is labelled as the operational strategy, so complete allocation-stage implementation is not independently established. Geographic deployment, executable dependencies and result uncertainty remain unclear. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this package. GAMS access may carry separate conditions; neither code nor results were downloaded or reproduced.
